gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.dst) Game Save (North America)

format: DeSmuME save state: DeSmuME state version 12, DeSmuME 0x163dc; ROM POKEMON HG IPKE rev 0; MMU chunk version 8, backup device version 5, addr_size 3, 524288 bytes; the save is 512 KiB

rom.name: Pokemon - HeartGold Version (USA).nds
rom.note: a dump of this game code whose sha1 is not in the No-Intro DAT (the area after the used ROM size is blank); the region in the name is a guess

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-desmume-state.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 524288 --stem 'Pokemon - HeartGold Version (USA)' --out DIR: takes the battery save out of the DeSmuME state; fits it to the 524288-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file
